You_need: 180 ml white rum; 96 g Lebanese cucumber, sliced, peel striped, stem end off
Instruction: Slice the cucumber. Stripe the peel and cut off the stem end.
Put the cucumber and 180 ml rum in a jar. Cap it. Keep it in the cool room.
STRAIN AT 24 h (never past 36 h).
Strain through a sieve, then a coffee filter.
Add 90 ml plain rum to the strained liquid.
Bottle in an amber bottle, filled to the top. Label with the date.
Method and amounts to be added once Ari gives them.

You_need: 300 ml gin; 32 g sun-dried tomatoes, patted dry; 6 g rosemary (last 4 h only); 150 ml plain gin (after straining)
Instruction: Put 300 ml gin and the tomatoes in a jar. Cap it. Keep it in the cool room.
Add the rosemary for the last 4 h.
STRAIN AT 24 h.
Strain through a sieve, then a coffee filter. If cloudy, chill and filter again.
Add 150 ml plain gin. Bottle and label.

You_need: 300 ml vodka; 64 g cornichons, sliced and drained; 1 g mustard seeds, lightly cracked (from the start); 2 g fresh dill (last 6 h only); 150 ml plain vodka (after straining)
Instruction: Put 300 ml vodka, the cornichons and the mustard seeds in a jar. Cap it. Keep it in the cool room.
Add the dill for the last 6 h.
STRAIN AT 24 h.
Strain through a sieve, then a coffee filter. Taste: tangy, not harshly acidic.
Add 150 ml plain vodka. Bottle and label.

You_need: 200 ml vodka; 10 g black peppercorns, coarsely cracked
Instruction: Put the vodka and the pepper in a jar. Cap it. Keep it in the cool room.
STRAIN AT 12 h (never past 24 h).
Strain through a sieve, then a coffee filter.
Bottle in an amber bottle, filled to the top. Label.

You_need: 1000 g frozen strawberries; 400 g white sugar; 200 g demerara sugar; 3 g black peppercorns, coarsely cracked; 120 ml vinegar (FORVM Chardonnay); 21 g citric acid; 7 g malic acid; 1.5 g salt; 5 ml potassium sorbate 10% (optional)
Instruction: Day 1: put the strawberries, both sugars and the pepper in a container. Keep it in the cool room for 24 h.
Keep: Fridge. At least 14 days (Ari); estimate 3-4 weeks.

Instruction: Day 2: strain (you get about 1 L).
Whisk in the vinegar, citric acid, malic acid, salt and sorbate until dissolved.
Taste: 15 ml shrub + 45 ml soda should taste like bright strawberry soda.
Bottle, filled to the top. Label with the date. Rest 2 days before use.

You_need: 480 g canned apricot halves (from an 825 g can); 170 g can syrup (half); 6 g malic acid; 3 g citric acid; 1 g salt; 5 ml potassium sorbate 10%
Instruction: Put everything in the blender.
Keep: Fridge, 10 days. Freeze in 300 ml bags. Esky with ice to the neck during service.

Instruction: Blend on high for 1 min. Do not sieve.
Bottle. Label 'contains preservative 202' and the date.

You_need: 3 L rescued soft red wine; 8 allspice berries, cracked; 15 g fresh ginger, sliced; 1 cinnamon quill; Peel and juice of 2 oranges; 2 jars Morello cherries (last 20 min); Sugar and a tiny pinch of salt (amounts: Ari's usual)
Instruction: Put the wine, allspice, ginger, cinnamon and orange peel and juice in a pot.
Simmer uncovered. Add the sugar and salt.
Add the cherries for the last 20 min.
Reduce the whole pot to 1.5 L.
Strain twice. Cool and bottle.
Use 500 ml per Sangria Tinto batch (see the batching sheet).

You_need: 150 g Green Queen olives, drained; 150 ml jar brine; 150 ml cold boiled water; 3 g citric acid
Instruction: Blitz everything for 30-60 s.
Strain through a coffee filter. Skim off any oil.
Heat the strained liquid to 72 C for 15 s.
Cool in an ice bath.
Pour into sanitised bottles, filled to the top. Label.

You_need: 20 g salt; Water, up to 100 ml
Instruction: Dissolve the salt in a little water.
Top up to 100 ml. Bottle in a squeeze bottle and label.
1 ml = 0.2 g salt.

You_need: 10 g potassium sorbate; Water, up to 100 ml
Instruction: Dissolve the sorbate in about 80 ml water.
Top up to 100 ml. Bottle and label.
